coming_up_next.summary: Requests become Availability requests with their Proposed rehearsals nested under them, the group page lists upcoming confirmed rehearsals, and the schedule gets a calendar view of who is free.
coming_up_next.title: Availability requests and their proposed rehearsals

recommended_steps.detail: Follow the Phase 23 END record's demo on your phone; check a member who had weekly times sees them as dates.
recommended_steps.title: Walk the User Demo

see_for_yourself.expected: Each change shows Saving then Saved; after the reload the dates show their times and the count is kept.
steps: On your phone, open the group's open request as a member.
Drag 7 to 10 PM on the hour bar and tick two dates.
Switch to List, tick one more and untick one, change the rehearsal count, then reload.
see_for_yourself.title: Give times as a member

see_for_yourself.expected: The heat map counts the member's dates, and your tick saves the same way.
steps: Open the same request as the organizer and open Your times below the heat map.
see_for_yourself.title: Your own times as an organizer

what_just_landed.detail: A request opens on a calendar of its dates (or a list you can tick several in): pick a stretch on the hour bar, tick dates, and each saves straight away with Saving and Saved. Each date shows its time; unticking clears it.
what_just_landed.title: Times are given on the request

what_just_landed.detail: How many rehearsals you can make in the span saves as you change it; Send my answer and the My times list are gone.
what_just_landed.title: The rehearsal count saves itself

what_just_landed.detail: Weekly availability and the My availability page are gone; saved weekly times become dates for the next 8 weeks when this deploys. Organizers give their own times in a folded section below the heat map, and new members land on the open request.
what_just_landed.title: My availability is retired
